title: LintEval: Benchmarking LLMs on Linter-Guided File Refactoring
abstract: arXiv:2610.20027v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Linters are widely used in code maintenance and real-time IDE editing to surface lint alerts related to performance, style, error-prone, and other patterns in source files. However, existing code benchmarks do not explicitly evaluate linter-guided file refactoring, where models must reduce lint alerts in source files with correct initial functionality while satisfying functionality preservation. We introduce LintEval, a multilingual benchmark for linter-guided file refactoring across C++, Python, and Java, comprising 13,061 programs with correct initial functionality and 171,662 lint alerts extracted using language-specific linters. LintEval jointly evaluates functionality preservation, lint alert reduction, new alert avoidance, and edit minimality. Experiments reveal a persistent trade-off: closed-source commercial models reach up to 90.4% Reduction@P but achieve only 67.1%-68.3% Pass@1, while several open-source small models show low

translated_title: LintEval：基于Linter引导的文件重构对大语言模型进行基准评测
translated_abstract: Linter（代码检查工具）被广泛应用于代码维护和IDE实时编辑中，用于揭示源文件中与性能、风格、易错模式等相关的lint告警。然而，现有的代码基准测试并未显式评估linter引导的文件重构任务，即模型必须在保持源文件原有功能正确性的前提下减少lint告警。我们提出了LintEval，一个面向C++、Python和Java的linter引导文件重构多语言基准，包含13,061个初始功能正确的程序以及通过语言特定linter提取的171,662条lint告警。LintEval联合评估功能保持、lint告警减少、新告警规避以及编辑最小化。实验揭示了一个持续存在的权衡：闭源商业模型的Reduction@P最高可达90.4%，但Pass@1仅为67.1%–68.3%，而若干开源小模型则表现出较低的……
tldr: 该论文提出LintEval，一个覆盖C++、Python和Java的多语言基准，用于评测大语言模型在linter引导的文件重构中减少lint告警的能力，实验揭示了告警减少与功能保持之间的持续权衡。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces LintEval, a multilingual benchmark across C++, Python, and Java for evaluating LLMs on linter-guided file refactoring, revealing a persistent trade-off between lint alert reduction and functionality preservation.
